items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: He said no, I've got a man, an impresario from Europe. A man named Leonidoff.

ctx.x: And then one day Lyons come in and said to me, "How would you like to go to Europe?" I looked at him as if to say, "Are you kidding?" He said no, I've got a man, an impresario from Europe. A man named Leonidoff. Not the one in Radio City. This was, he spelled his name -L-e-n-i-d-o-w, which is the same thing. W is double f in Russian, see? And they were Russian, see.
